purpose: Measure 200-update timing, memory, numerical stability, and validation-path behavior before W08; not scientific model selection.

data_roles.training: 64 deterministic rows, one per training stratum-view bucket
data_roles.validation: 64 deterministic rows, one per validation stratum-view bucket

initialization: COCO_V1 from managed copied historical artifact

optimizer.name: SGD
optimizer.precision_failure_rule: Stop on nonfinite loss or gradient before any optimizer update.
optimizer.precision_diagnostic_amendment: After the deterministic fp16 update-1 failure, run the same bounded plan with bf16 autocast; this is a numerical recovery check, not outcome-based model selection.

limitations: Inherited label semantics remain unresolved at W04.
The pilot cannot choose an endpoint, architecture, ratio, lambda, or stopping rule.
Only training and validation data may be read.
